name: Sofia Vargas Ramirez
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport began in Bogotá, where she spent her childhood tinkering with her grandfather's old motorbike. This early exposure ignited a passion for mechanics that led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, she gained experience at a local machine shop, honing her skills in precision machining and fabrication.

Driven by a desire to work on high-performance vehicles, Sofia moved to the United States and secured a position with Richard Childress Racing. She approaches her role with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring that every component meets the highest standards of quality and performance. Sofia's ability to diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues quickly and efficiently makes her a valuable asset to the team. Her colleagues know her for her unwavering focus and dedication to the craft, as well as her ability to troubleshoot any engine problem.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided and pulled back into a practical bun.
physical.description: Sofia is a petite woman with a focused gaze and perpetually grease-stained hands.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an exact point before starting any task.
Listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
